neighbor_rule: same OOF fold, same class, different physical_pair_id
lower_rule: q05 of pair-independent nearest-neighbor distance normalized by pair-independent instance k5 radius when floor supported; otherwise zero
normalization_selection_rule: Choose global if its mean pairwise class Wasserstein is within 10% of the best; otherwise class-adaptive if within 10% of instance-adaptive; otherwise instance-adaptive
cross_version_robust_rule: normalization unchanged, variation-floor status unchanged, and every beta relative change <=20%
instability_rule: unstable iff k10 is unsupported for any source or at least four classes have k5-radius CV >1.0
